en: An old black‑and‑white/sepia postcard showing a small town street with unpaved road and wooden houses on both sides. A few people stand or walk along the street. On the left is a two‑storey building with a business sign; more wooden houses extend into the distance. Handwritten text is visible at the bottom, along with printed captions in German indicating greetings from Oberpahlen and the photographer's credit.
